model_annotation: This image displays a nested donut chart comparing two categorical distributions: "Ambiguity Std" represented by the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" represented by the inner ring. The inner ring is composed of three segments in lighter pastel blue tones: "Max: 1" in medium-light blue represents 47.7%, "Max: 2" in light blue constitutes 38.0%, and "Max: 3" in very light blue accounts for 14.2%. Bold, black percentage labels are printed directly over or inside their respective slices for both rings.
